ai.purpose: Establish the foundational axiomatic framework upon which all subsequent books in the AI Edition are built. Defines core constructs: structure, relation, constraint, invariant, and transformation. Provides the ontological base for structural reasoning across all domains.
ai.summary: Book 1 lays the axiomatic ground for the entire AI Edition. It introduces the primitive constructs — structure, node, relation, constraint, invariant, and transformation — and specifies how they compose into coherent formal systems. No subsequent book can be interpreted without the definitions established here.

references: INV-001: Structural Identity — every structure has a unique identity determined by its constituent relations
INV-002: Constraint Preservation — valid transformations must preserve all declared constraints
INV-003: Relational Closure — the set of relations within a structure is closed under defined operations
INV-004: Ontological Primacy — primitives are irreducible; no primitive is defined in terms of another primitive
